sentences.text:
There is an award dated 25.01.2013 in favour of the petitioner NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:28467 2 WP-38511-2025 awarding compensation for acquisition of the land under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.

While awarding the compensation,
additional compensation, solatium and interest were not awarded in favour of the petitioner / land owner.

The National Highway Authority of India has filed a miscellaneous application before the Hon'ble Apex Court raising an issue whether the Section 3J of the National Highway Act, 1956 has become unconstitutional as a retrospective effect.

entities.text: Union of India v/s Tarsem Singh reported in AIRONLINE 2025 SC 94
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the foregoing analysis, we find no merit in the contentions raised by the Applicant, NHAI.

We reaffirm the principles established in Tarsem Singh (supra)
regarding the beneficial nature of granting 'solatium' and 'interest' while emphasizing the need to avoid creating unjust classifications lacking intelligible differentia.
Consequently, we deem it appropriate to dismiss the present Miscellaneous Application.

26. Leave is granted in the other connected matters, and all the appeals are disposed of with a direction to the Competent Authority to calculate the amount of 'solatium'
and 'interest' in accordance with the directions issued in Tarsem Singh (supra) .

In this context, the appeal arising out of SLP (C) Diary No. 52538/2023 is dismissed, as the challenge therein pertains to the High Court's refusal to award Additional Market Value as another component of the compensation, while 'solatium' and 'interest' have already been granted."
04.
Learned counsel appearing for the respondent after going through the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Apex Court in case of Tarsem Singh (Supra) is not disputing the aforesaid facts.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:28467 3 WP-38511-2025 05.
In view of the above, this Writ Petition is allowed.

The claims i.e. additional compensation under Section 23(1-A), Solatium under Section 23(2) and interest under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 are allowed and the same be paid to the petitioner within a period of six weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Certified copy, as per rules.
(VIVEK RUSIA) (ALOK A
JUDGE JUD
